channel.title: The Grant Desk - Visual & Media Arts, US, next 90 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Visual & Media Arts, US, next 90 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 4 new grants - week of 10 Aug 2026

    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000 across two years. Request must not exceed 25 percent of the organisation's annual operating budget. No formal match, but the 25 percent...
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Project Grants for Small-Scale Organizations (Fall 2026 round)
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · USD 20,000 to 30,000 toward direct costs such as artist payments and production. No application fee.
